caseNameFull: Boire, Regional Director, Twelfth Region, National Labor Relations Board v. Greyhound Corporation
attorneys: Solicitor General Cox, Stuart Rothman, Dominick L. Manoli, Norton J. Come, James C. Paras and Herman M. Levy for petitioner. Warren E. Hall, Jr. for respondent. I. J. Gromfine and Herman Sternstein for Amalgamated Association of Street, Electric Railway & Motor Coach Employes of America, AFL-CIO, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition. Alexander E. Wilson, Jr. for Floors, Inc., as amicus curiae, in opposition.

opinions.text: The motion of Amalgamated Association of Street, Electric Railway & Motor Coach Employes of America, AFL-CIO, for leave to file a brief, as amicus curiae, is granted. The petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit is also granted.
